# SEV3 execution contract
English requirement and contract bodies are canonical. Read the complete current
phase and the exact-source packet before work. A reference from another phase is
mandatory compatibility knowledge, NOT permission to implement its tasks. Inspect
actual repository contracts and closed handover evidence before claiming reuse.
Do not infer missing business rules or weaken gates to fit context. No automatic
recursive reading of phase links. Source-specific expansion needs a question/reason.
Only Looprch controls verified TODO completion; no checked box is proof by itself.
